import argparse
import sys


def transform(text, upper=False, reverse=False):
    if upper:
        text = text.upper()
    if reverse:
        text = text[::-1]
    return text


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Join TEXT arguments with single spaces and apply transform()."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--upper",
        action="store_true",
        help="uppercase the text",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--reverse",
        action="store_true",
        help="reverse the text",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "text",
        metavar="TEXT",
        nargs="+",
        help="text fragments joined with single spaces",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    result = transform(" ".join(args.text), upper=args.upper, reverse=args.reverse)
    print(result)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
